description: Find the optimal (shortest by travel time) route through a set of 2-12 coordinates. Solves the Traveling Salesman Problem to determine the best visiting order. Supports options for starting point, ending point, and whether to return to start.

annotations.description: Additional metadata to include for each route segment

coordinates.description: Array of {longitude, latitude} coordinate pairs to optimize a route through. The V1 API supports 2-12 coordinates and returns the optimal visiting order.

destination.description: Location to end the trip. IMPORTANT: If you set roundtrip=false you MUST set destination="last" (and source="first"). The Mapbox V1 API rejects roundtrip=false with destination="any". "any" allows the optimizer to pick any coordinate as the end (only valid when roundtrip=true).

language.description: Language for instructions (if steps=true). ISO 639-1 code (e.g., "en", "es").

profile.description: Routing profile to use for optimization

roundtrip.description: Whether to return to the starting point. Default true returns a closed loop through the coordinates. Set false for one-way trips — REQUIRES source="first" AND destination="last" together. Passing roundtrip=false without both endpoint constraints will fail.

source.description: Location to start the trip. IMPORTANT: If you set roundtrip=false you MUST set source="first" (and destination="last"). The Mapbox V1 API rejects roundtrip=false with source="any". "any" allows the optimizer to pick any coordinate as the start (only valid when roundtrip=true).

name: optimization_tool

code.description: Status code (e.g., "Ok" for success, error code otherwise)

mapboxRender.description: Map-payload reference for `render_map_tool`. Surfaced so the LLM can chain the next call without re-emitting geometry.

ref.description: Server-side payload reference. Pass to `render_map_tool` via `payload_refs: ["<this ref>"]` to display the data on a live Mapbox GL JS map.

message.description: Error message if code is not "Ok"

trips.description: Array containing the optimized trip (typically 1 trip for all waypoints)

geometry.description: Route geometry as GeoJSON LineString or encoded polyline string

annotation.description: Detailed annotations for the leg (if requested)

distance.description: Distance for this leg in meters

duration.description: Duration for this leg in seconds

waypoints.description: Input coordinates snapped to the road network in optimized order

name.description: Name of the road/path at this point

trips_index.description: Index of the trip this waypoint belongs to

waypoint_index.description: Position of this waypoint within its trip

title: Optimize Multi-Stop Route
